title: Who owns the land
text: Nearly three quarters of San Luis Obispo County is private land, or land not listed as protected, as of 2024. The Bureau of Land Management has the biggest public share, about 11 percent of the county, run from its Bakersfield Field Office. Los Padres National Forest covers about 8 percent. The state's Carrizo Plains Ecological Reserve covers nearly 2 percent, and Camp Roberts, the National Guard training post, about 1 percent.
